property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address that may revert, the reference contract always reverts (so the external call failures do not yield a successful return), whereas the mutant can return true despite one of the external calls failing; therefore the property is that transfer(...) never returns successfully when a callee invocation reverts, which the mutant violates for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after the external call so failures of the caddress.call do not revert, changing return behavior when calls fail (original would revert; mutant continues and returns true).
